declarations.name: weighted_error_bound

    (weight error : I → ℝ) (bound : ℝ)
    (positive : ∀ i, 0 ≤ weight i) (normalized : ∑ i, weight i = 1)
    (bounded : ∀ i, |error i| ≤ bound) :
    |∑ i, weight i * error i| ≤ bound

declarations.name: anchored_update_error
declarations.signature:
theorem anchored_update_error {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (weight error : I → ℝ) (alpha measurementError bound sensorBound : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (positive : ∀ i, 0 ≤ weight i) (normalized : ∑ i, weight i = 1)
    (bounded : ∀ i, |error i| ≤ bound) (sensor : |measurementError| ≤ sensorBound) :
    |(1-alpha)*(∑ i, weight i*error i) + alpha*measurementError| ≤
      (1-alpha)*bound+alpha*sensorBound

declarations.name: adaptive_history_error_bound

theorem adaptive_history_error_bound {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (weights : Nat → I → I → ℝ) (measurement : Nat → I → ℝ)
    (alpha initialBound sensorBound : ℝ) (initial : I → ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (positive : ∀ n i j, 0 ≤ weights n i j)
    (normalized : ∀ n i, ∑ j, weights n i j = 1)
    (sensor : ∀ n i, |measurement n i| ≤ sensorBound)
    (start : ∀ i, |initial i| ≤ initialBound) :
    ∀ n i, |evolution weights measurement alpha initial n i| ≤
      (1-alpha)^n * initialBound+sensorBound*(1-(1-alpha)^n)

declarations.name: universal_protection_held
declarations.signature:
theorem universal_protection_held {X Part : Type*} [MetricSpace X] {Ω ι : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (accounts : Finset ι) (Ev' : ι → Set Ω) (δ : ι → ENNReal) (G : Set Ω)
    (hG : Gᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ accounts, Ev' i) (hδ : ∀ i ∈ accounts, μ (Ev' i) ≤ δ i)
    (p : S → Part → X) (T : Ω → S → C → Ev → S) (U : Ω → (Part → X) → C → Ev → Part → X)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : (Part → X) → O) (ctrl : Ω → List O → C)
    (env : Ω → List O → C → Ev) (s₀ : Ω → S)
                                
    {rec : Part → X} {ε εf t dmin : ℝ} {Code : Set X} (hrec : ∀ x, rec x ∈ Code)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ Code, ∀ c' ∈ Code, c ≠ c' → dmin ≤ dist c c') (ht : 2 * t < dmin)
    {dec : X → X} (hdecC : ∀ y, dec y ∈ Code) (hnear : ∀ y, ∀ c ∈ Code, dist y (dec y) ≤ dist y c)
    (hεf : εf ≤ ε)
                                           
    (scope : Set Part)
    (hlaw : ∀ (F : Set (Set Part)) (o : Set Part),
      Snuffy.Law.ProjMax scope F o → ¬ Snuffy.Law.NeedlessLoss₁ F o)
                                                 
    (pre : Ω → (Part → X) → C → Ev → Part → X)
    (hcert : ∀ ω ∈ G, (∀ s c e, p (T ω s c e) = U ω (p s) c e) ∧
      (∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s)) ∧ (∀ x, Continues rec ε (p (s₀ ω)) x) ∧
      (∀ a c e x, x ∈ scope → Continues rec ε a x → dist (pre ω a c e x) (rec x) ≤ t) ∧
      (∀ a c e x, x ∈ scope → dist (U ω a c e x) (dec (pre ω a c e x)) ≤ εf))
    (horizon : ℕ) :
    (∀ ω ∈ G, ∀ k ≤ horizon, ∀ x,
      Continues rec ε (p (Snuffy.Composition.run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x) ∧
    μ {ω | ∃ k ≤ horizon, ¬ ∀ x,
      Continues rec ε (p (Snuffy.Composition.run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x}
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ accounts, δ i

theorem holding_cycle_physical {Y E Part : Type*} [MetricSpace Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {recY : Part → Y} {recE : Part → E} {ε εf Δ : ℝ} {d N : ℕ} {lt : ℝ} {Code : Set Y}
    (hrecY : ∀ x, recY x ∈ Code)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ Code, ∀ c' ∈ Code, c ≠ c' → (d : ℝ) ≤ dist c c')
    {dec : Y → Y} (hdecC : ∀ y, dec y ∈ Code) (hnear : ∀ y, ∀ c ∈ Code, dist y (dec y) ≤ dist y c)
    (hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ lt) (hd : 2 * lt < d) (hεf : εf ≤ ε)
    {ħ : ℝ} (hħ : 0 < ħ) {H₀ V : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E}
    (hH₀ : ∀ s, IsSelfAdjoint (H₀ s)) (hHV : ∀ s, IsSelfAdjoint (H₀ s + V s))
    {W : ℝ} (hW : ∀ s, ‖V s‖ ≤ W) (hzero : ∀ x s, H₀ s (recE x) = 0)
    {a : Part → Y × E} {x : Part} (hc : ContinuesP recY recE ε a x)
                                                                                        
    {yPre : Y} (hfault : dist yPre (recY x) ≤ N)
    {ψ : ℝ → E} (hψ : Snuffy.SpeedLimit.Solves ħ (fun s => H₀ s + V s) ψ) (hψ1 : ‖ψ 0‖ = 1)
    (hψ0 : ψ 0 = (a x).2)
    {next : Y × E} (hcorr : next.1 = dec yPre) (hrefresh : ‖next.2 - recE x‖ ≤ εf) :
    (next.1 = recY x ∧ ‖next.2 - recE x‖ ≤ ε) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 Δ, ‖ψ s - recE x‖ ≤ ε + W / ħ * Δ

theorem reactive_lockstep (p : S → A) (T : S → C → Ev → S) (U : A → C → Ev → A)
    (hcomm : ∀ s c e, p (T s c e) = U (p s) c e)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (hobs : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → Ev) (s₀ : S) :
    ∀ k, p (run T obsS ctrl env s₀ k).1 = (run U obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).1 ∧
      (run T obsS ctrl env s₀ k).2 = (run U obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).2

    (hcomm₁ : ∀ s c, p (T₁ s c) = U₁ (p s) c) (hcomm₂ : ∀ m e, p (T₂ m e) = U₂ (p m) e)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (hobs : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → O → Ev) (s₀ : S) :
    ∀ k, p (run₂ T₁ T₂ obsS ctrl env s₀ k).1 = (run₂ U₁ U₂ obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).1 ∧
      (run₂ T₁ T₂ obsS ctrl env s₀ k).2 = (run₂ U₁ U₂ obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).2

    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → Ev) (s₀ : S)
    (Inv : A → Prop) (hinit : Inv (p s₀)) (hpres : ∀ a c e, Inv a → Inv (U a c e)) :

declarations.name: theorem8_composition
declarations.signature:
theorem theorem8_composition {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (accounts : Finset ι) (E : ι → Set Ω) (δ : ι → ENNReal) (G : Set Ω)
    (hG : Gᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ accounts, E i) (hδ : ∀ i ∈ accounts, μ (E i) ≤ δ i)
    (p : S → A) (T : Ω → S → C → Ev → S) (U : Ω → A → C → Ev → A)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (ctrl : Ω → List O → C) (env : Ω → List O → C → Ev)
    (s₀ : Ω → S) (Inv : A → Prop)
    (hcert : ∀ ω ∈ G, (∀ s c e, p (T ω s c e) = U ω (p s) c e) ∧
      (∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s)) ∧ Inv (p (s₀ ω)) ∧ (∀ a c e, Inv a → Inv (U ω a c e)))
    (horizon : ℕ) :
    (∀ ω ∈ G, ∀ k ≤ horizon, Inv (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1)) ∧
    μ {ω | ∃ k ≤ horizon, ¬ Inv (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1)}
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ accounts, δ i

theorem bandwidth_contraction {R B a : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : 0 < B) (ha : 0 < a)
    (haOne : a ≤ 1) (anchor evidence initial : ℝ) :
    rate a (R / (R + B)) = R * (1 - a) / (R + B) ∧
      0 ≤ rate a (R / (R + B)) ∧ rate a (R / (R + B)) < 1 ∧
      (∀ s, step a (R / (R + B)) anchor evidence s = s →
        s = equilibrium a (R / (R + B)) anchor evidence) ∧
      ∀ n, run a (R / (R + B)) anchor evidence initial n
          - equilibrium a (R / (R + B)) anchor evidence =
        rate a (R / (R + B)) ^ n
          * (initial - equilibrium a (R / (R + B)) anchor evidence)

declarations.name: certified_hold_nothing_lands
declarations.signature:
theorem certified_hold_nothing_lands (enrol : Nat → List Nat) (start : State)
    (before during : List Op) (c : Context)
    (retired : (step enrol (run enrol start before) (.retire c)).2 =
      .floor c (c.generation + 1))
    (noRelease : ∀ d, Op.release d ∉ during)
    (target : UPTFence.St) (attempts : List UPTFence.Ev)
    (tokens : ∀ g, g ∈ target.minted →
      TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g)
    (later : ∀ g, UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ attempts →
      TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g) :
    (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply target (.raise (c.generation + 1))) attempts).log = target.log

declarations.name: both_targets_held
declarations.signature:
theorem both_targets_held (enrol : Nat → List Nat) (start : State)
    (before during : List Op) (c : Context)
    (retired : (step enrol (run enrol start before) (.retire c)).2 =
      .floor c (c.generation + 1))
    (noRelease : ∀ d, Op.release d ∉ during)
    (journal sink : UPTFence.St) (jEvents kEvents : List UPTFence.Ev)
    (jTokens : ∀ g, g ∈ journal.minted → TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g)
    (kTokens : ∀ g, g ∈ sink.minted → TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g)
    (jLater : ∀ g, UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ jEvents → TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g)
    (kLater : ∀ g, UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ kEvents → TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ .retire c :: during) g) :
    (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply journal (.raise (c.generation + 1))) jEvents).log = journal.log ∧
    (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply sink (.raise (c.generation + 1))) kEvents).log = sink.log

declarations.name: tally_mono
declarations.signature:
theorem tally_mono {α : Type} (p q : α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ xs → p x = true → q x = true) : tally p xs ≤ tally q xs

declarations.name: quorum_has_honest
declarations.signature:
theorem quorum_has_honest {α : Type} (xs : List α) (fault vote : α → Bool) (f : Nat)
    (hf : tally fault xs ≤ f) (hq : f < tally vote xs) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ vote x = true ∧ fault x = false

declarations.name: two_tallies_bound
declarations.signature:
theorem two_tallies_bound {α : Type} (xs : List α) (fault a b : α → Bool)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ xs → a x = true → b x = true → fault x = true) :
    tally a xs + tally b xs ≤ xs.length + tally fault xs

declarations.name: quorum_intersection
declarations.signature:
theorem quorum_intersection {α : Type} (xs : List α) (fault a b : α → Bool) (f q : Nat)
    (hf : tally fault xs ≤ f) (ha : q ≤ tally a xs) (hb : q ≤ tally b xs)
    (size : xs.length + f < 2 * q) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ a x = true ∧ b x = true ∧ fault x = false

declarations.name: certificates_do_not_equivocate
declarations.signature:
theorem certificates_do_not_equivocate {α : Type} (roster : List Nat)
    (fault a b : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat) (u v : List α) (durable : Nat → List α)
    (hf : tally fault roster ≤ f) (size : roster.length = 3 * f + 1)
    (qa : 2 * f + 1 ≤ tally a roster) (qb : 2 * f + 1 ≤ tally b roster)
    (authA : ∀ r, r ∈ roster → fault r = false → a r = true → Prefix u (durable r))
    (authB : ∀ r, r ∈ roster → fault r = false → b r = true → Prefix v (durable r))
    (samePosition : u.length = v.length) : u = v

declarations.name: cyc_succ_apply
declarations.signature:
theorem cyc_succ_apply (k : ℕ) (K : Fin (k + 1) → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E) :
    cyc (k + 1) K x = (K (Fin.last k)).starProjection (cyc k (fun i => K i.castSucc) x)

declarations.name: adj_succ_apply
declarations.signature:
theorem adj_succ_apply (k : ℕ) (K : Fin (k + 1) → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (w : E) :
    adj (k + 1) K w = adj k (fun i => K i.castSucc) ((K (Fin.last k)).starProjection w)

declarations.name: norm_cyc_le
declarations.signature:
theorem norm_cyc_le : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E), ‖cyc k K x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

declarations.name: norm_adj_le
declarations.signature:
theorem norm_adj_le : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (w : E), ‖adj k K w‖ ≤ ‖w‖

declarations.name: inner_cyc
declarations.signature:
theorem inner_cyc : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (z w : E),
    ⟪cyc k K z, w⟫_ℂ = ⟪z, adj k K w⟫_ℂ

declarations.name: cyc_fix
declarations.signature:
theorem cyc_fix : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E), (∀ i, x ∈ K i) → cyc k K x = x

declarations.name: fixed_of_norm_eq
declarations.signature:
private theorem fixed_of_norm_eq (K : Submodule ℂ E) [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] {w : E}
    (h : ‖K.starProjection w‖ = ‖w‖) : K.starProjection w = w

declarations.name: mem_of_norm_adj_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_of_norm_adj_eq : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)

declarations.name: energy

theorem energy : ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Submodule ℂ E)
    [∀ i, (K i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E),
    ‖x - cyc k K x‖ ^ 2 ≤ k * (‖x‖ ^ 2 - ‖cyc k K x‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: iter_succ
declarations.signature: theorem iter_succ (n : ℕ) (x : E) : (cyc k K ^ (n + 1)) x = cyc k K ((cyc k K ^ n) x)

declarations.name: iter_shift
declarations.signature: theorem iter_shift (n : ℕ) (z : E) : (cyc k K ^ n) (cyc k K z) = (cyc k K ^ (n + 1)) z

declarations.name: norm_iter_le
declarations.signature: theorem norm_iter_le (n : ℕ) (x : E) : ‖(cyc k K ^ n) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

declarations.name: iter_fix
declarations.signature: theorem iter_fix (n : ℕ) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ K i) : (cyc k K ^ n) x = x

declarations.name: tendsto_iter_sub_succ

theorem tendsto_iter_sub_succ (z : E) :

declarations.name: tendsto_zero_of_mem_orthogonal

declarations.name: finite_branch_payoff_bound

theorem finite_branch_payoff_bound {I : Type} [Fintype I]

    (positive : ∀ i, 0 ≤ probability i) (normalized : ∑ i, probability i = 1)

declarations.name: duration_reward_bound

declarations.name: efficiency_gain_pays_cost

declarations.name: dominant_action_survives_mixture

theorem dominant_action_survives_mixture {I : Type} [Fintype I]

    (positive : ∀ i, 0 ≤ probability i) (normalized : ∑ i, probability i = 1)

declarations.name: two_provider_unique_balanced_cost

declarations.name: rank_criterion

declarations.name: surviving_disjoint_route
declarations.signature:
theorem surviving_disjoint_route {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (faultBudget : Nat)
    (routes : Fin (faultBudget+1) → Finset V) (faults : Finset V)
    (separate : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (routes i) (routes j))
    (bounded : faults.card ≤ faultBudget) :

declarations.name: certified_repair_meets_deadline
declarations.signature:
theorem certified_repair_meets_deadline {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (faultBudget : Nat)
    (routes : Fin (faultBudget+1) → Finset V) (faults : Finset V)
    (separate : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (routes i) (routes j))
    (bounded : faults.card ≤ faultBudget)
    (detection repair service : Fin (faultBudget+1) → Nat)
    (detectBound repairBound serviceBound deadline : Nat)
    (timing : ∀ i, Disjoint (routes i) faults →
      detection i ≤ detectBound ∧ repair i ≤ repairBound ∧ service i ≤ serviceBound)

    (p : S → A) (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O)
    (commandSquare : ∀ s c, p (sourceCommand s c) = abstractCommand (p s) c)
    (responseSquare : ∀ s e, p (sourceResponse s e) = abstractResponse (p s) e)
    (fidelity : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (controller : History O (C × O × O) → C)
    (environment : History O (C × O × O) → C → O → E)
    (z : Configuration S O (C × O × O)) :
    mapState p (phaseTick sourceCommand sourceResponse obsS controller environment z) =
    phaseTick abstractCommand abstractResponse obsA controller environment (mapState p z)

declarations.name: two_phase_lockstep
declarations.signature:
theorem two_phase_lockstep {S A C E O : Type}
    (sourceCommand : S → C → S) (abstractCommand : A → C → A)
    (sourceResponse : S → E → S) (abstractResponse : A → E → A)
    (p : S → A) (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O)
    (commandSquare : ∀ s c, p (sourceCommand s c) = abstractCommand (p s) c)
    (responseSquare : ∀ s e, p (sourceResponse s e) = abstractResponse (p s) e)
    (fidelity : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (controller : History O (C × O × O) → C)
    (environment : History O (C × O × O) → C → O → E)
    (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    mapState p (iterate (phaseTick sourceCommand sourceResponse obsS controller environment) n
      ⟨s, ⟨obsS s, []⟩⟩) =
    iterate (phaseTick abstractCommand abstractResponse obsA controller environment) n
      ⟨p s, ⟨obsA (p s), []⟩⟩

    (hk0 : 0 ≤ k) (hk1 : k < 1) (hfixed : R fixed = fixed)

declarations.name: universal_protection
declarations.signature:
theorem universal_protection {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
                             
    (accounts : Finset ι) (E : ι → Set Ω) (δ : ι → ENNReal) (G : Set Ω)
    (hG : Gᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ accounts, E i) (hδ : ∀ i ∈ accounts, μ (E i) ≤ δ i)
                                                                     
    (p : S → A) (T : Ω → S → C → Ev → S) (U : Ω → A → C → Ev → A)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (ctrl : Ω → List O → C) (env : Ω → List O → C → Ev)
    (s₀ : Ω → S)
                                                                     
    (continues : A → Part → Prop) (R H : Part → Prop) (hcover : ∀ x, R x ∨ H x)
    (hcert : ∀ ω ∈ G, (∀ s c e, p (T ω s c e) = U ω (p s) c e) ∧
      (∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s)) ∧ (∀ x, continues (p (s₀ ω)) x) ∧
      (∀ x, R x → ∀ a c e, continues a x → continues (U ω a c e) x) ∧
      (∀ x, H x → ∀ a c e, continues a x → continues (U ω a c e) x))
    (horizon : ℕ)
                               
    {n : ℕ} {L : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, SemilatticeSup (L i)] {F : Set (∀ i, L i)}
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ⊔ y ∈ F) {o : ∀ i, L i} (ho : Aligned F o)
    (hn : 0 < n) (keeps : L ⟨0, hn⟩ → Part → Prop)
    (hkeeps : ∀ x y, x ≤ y → ∀ m, keeps x m → keeps y m) :
                                                         
    (∀ ω ∈ G, ∀ k ≤ horizon, ∀ x, continues (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x) ∧
                             
    μ {ω | ∃ k ≤ horizon, ¬ ∀ x, continues (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x}
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ accounts, δ i ∧
                                                
    (∀ q ∈ F, q = o ∨ LexLt q o) ∧
                  
    (∀ q ∈ F, ∀ m, keeps (q ⟨0, hn⟩) m → keeps (o ⟨0, hn⟩) m)

declarations.name: boundary_representatives_iff

theorem boundary_representatives_iff
    {Policy : Type u} {World : Type v} {O : Type w} {B : Type z}
    (feasible : Policy → Prop) (le : O → O → Prop)
    (trans : ∀ a b c, le a b → le b c → le a c)
    (outcome : Policy → World → O) (boundary : Policy → B) (rep : B → Policy)
    (implemented : ∀ b, feasible (rep b))
    (fibre : ∀ p, feasible p → ∀ world,
      le (outcome p world) (outcome (rep (boundary p)) world)) :
    (∃ p, Greatest feasible le outcome p) ↔
      ∃ b, ∀ c world, le (outcome (rep c) world) (outcome (rep b) world)

    (outcome : Policy → World → O) (boundary : Policy → B) (rep : B → Policy)
    (implemented : ∀ b, feasible (rep b))
    (fibre : ∀ p, feasible p → ∀ world,
      le (outcome p world) (outcome (rep (boundary p)) world))
    (b : B) (best : ∀ c world, le (outcome (rep c) world) (outcome (rep b) world)) :
    Greatest feasible le outcome (rep b)

    (outcome : Policy → World → O) (boundary : Policy → B) (rep : B → Policy)
    (implemented : ∀ b, feasible (rep b))
    (fibre : ∀ p, feasible p → ∀ world,
      UPTR14Rivals.LE stages (outcome p world) (outcome (rep (boundary p)) world)) :
    (∃ p, Greatest feasible (UPTR14Rivals.LE stages) outcome p) ↔
      ∃ b, ∀ c world,
        UPTR14Rivals.LE stages (outcome (rep c) world) (outcome (rep b) world)

    (square : ∀ s c e, p (T s c e) = U (p s) c e)
    (fidelity : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (controller : History O (C × O) → C)

    (fidelity : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (controller : History O (C × O) → C)
    (environment : History O (C × O) → C → E)
    (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    mapState p (iterate (tick T obsS controller environment) n

    (hcert : finish base (prefix ++ [j]) (fun k => k.budget) ≤ j.deadline)

declarations.name: demand_le_supply

theorem demand_le_supply (jobs : Finset J) (r d p : J → ℕ) (Av : Finset ℕ) (S : J → Finset ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ j ∈ jobs, (S j).card = p j)
    (hwin : ∀ j ∈ jobs, S j ⊆ Av.filter (fun t => r j ≤ t ∧ t < d j))
    (hdisj : (jobs : Set J).PairwiseDisjoint S) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ jobs.filter (fun j => a ≤ r j ∧ d j ≤ b), p j) ≤ (Av.filter (fun t => a ≤ t ∧ t < b)).card

    (S : Ω → J → Finset ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ ω ∈ Dset, ∀ j ∈ jobs, (S ω j).card = p j)
    (hwin : ∀ ω ∈ Dset, ∀ j ∈ jobs, S ω j ⊆ (Av ω).filter (fun t => r j ≤ t ∧ t < d j))
    (hdisj : ∀ ω ∈ Dset, (jobs : Set J).PairwiseDisjoint (S ω)) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∀ ω ∈ Dset, (∑ j ∈ jobs.filter (fun j => a ≤ r j ∧ d j ≤ b), p j) ≤
      ((Av ω).filter (fun t => a ≤ t ∧ t < b)).card

declarations.signature:
theorem reactive_lockstep (p : S → A) (T : S → C → Ev → S) (U : A → C → Ev → A)
    (hcomm : ∀ s c e, p (T s c e) = U (p s) c e)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (hobs : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → Ev) (s₀ : S) :
    ∀ k, p (run T obsS ctrl env s₀ k).1 = (run U obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).1 ∧
      (run T obsS ctrl env s₀ k).2 = (run U obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).2

    (hcomm₁ : ∀ s c, p (T₁ s c) = U₁ (p s) c) (hcomm₂ : ∀ m e, p (T₂ m e) = U₂ (p m) e)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (hobs : ∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s))
    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → O → Ev) (s₀ : S) :
    ∀ k, p (run₂ T₁ T₂ obsS ctrl env s₀ k).1 = (run₂ U₁ U₂ obsA ctrl env (p s₀) k).1 ∧

    (ctrl : List O → C) (env : List O → C → Ev) (s₀ : S)

declarations.name: theorem8_composition
declarations.signature:
theorem theorem8_composition {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (accounts : Finset ι) (E : ι → Set Ω) (δ : ι → ENNReal) (G : Set Ω)
    (hG : Gᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ accounts, E i) (hδ : ∀ i ∈ accounts, μ (E i) ≤ δ i)
    (p : S → A) (T : Ω → S → C → Ev → S) (U : Ω → A → C → Ev → A)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (ctrl : Ω → List O → C) (env : Ω → List O → C → Ev)
    (s₀ : Ω → S) (Inv : A → Prop)
    (hcert : ∀ ω ∈ G, (∀ s c e, p (T ω s c e) = U ω (p s) c e) ∧
      (∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s)) ∧ Inv (p (s₀ ω)) ∧ (∀ a c e, Inv a → Inv (U ω a c e)))
    (horizon : ℕ) :
    (∀ ω ∈ G, ∀ k ≤ horizon, Inv (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1)) ∧
    μ {ω | ∃ k ≤ horizon, ¬ Inv (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1)}
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ accounts, δ i

declarations.name: sq_pythagoras_step
chain_identity
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_identity (A B : Submodule ℂ E)
    [A.HasOrthogonalProjection] [B.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (x : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ A ⊓ B) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖tIterate A B x k - z‖ ^ 2 = ‖tIterate A B x (k + 1) - z‖ ^ 2
      + ‖tIterate A B x k - B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k)‖ ^ 2
      + ‖B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k)
          - A.starProjection (B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k))‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: sq_dist_antitone
declarations.signature:
theorem sq_dist_antitone (A B : Submodule ℂ E)
    [A.HasOrthogonalProjection] [B.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (x : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ A ⊓ B) :
    Antitone (fun k => ‖tIterate A B x k - z‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: sq_dist_tendsto
declarations.signature:
theorem sq_dist_tendsto (A B : Submodule ℂ E)

    (x : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ A ⊓ B) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => ‖tIterate A B x k - z‖ ^ 2) atTop (nhds L)

declarations.name: delta_tendsto_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem delta_tendsto_zero (A B : Submodule ℂ E)
    [A.HasOrthogonalProjection] [B.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (x : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ A ⊓ B) :
    Tendsto (fun k => ‖tIterate A B x k - z‖ ^ 2 - ‖tIterate A B x (k + 1) - z‖ ^ 2)
      atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: asymptotic_regularity
declarations.signature:
theorem asymptotic_regularity (A B : Submodule ℂ E)
    [A.HasOrthogonalProjection] [B.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun k => ‖tIterate A B x k - B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k)‖) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun k => ‖B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k)
        - A.starProjection (B.starProjection (tIterate A B x k))‖) atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: frontier_work_bound
declarations.signature:
theorem frontier_work_bound {r P : ℝ → ℝ} {T r0 v p' W d : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hv : 0 < v) (hp : 0 < p')
    (hac : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval r 0 T)
    (hnonneg : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ r s)
    (hr0 : r 0 = r0)
    (hspeed : ∀ᵐ s, s ∈ Icc 0 T → deriv r s ≤ v)
    (hpow : ∀ᵐ s, s ∈ Icc 0 T → p' * r s ^ (d - 1) ≤ P s)
    (hPint : IntervalIntegrable P volume 0 T)
    (hW : ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..T, P s ≤ W) :
    r T ^ d - r0 ^ d ≤ v * d / p' * W

declarations.name: necessary_radius

theorem necessary_radius {I0 It D u t r : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (ht : 0 < t) (hIt : 0 < It)
    (hItI0 : It ≤ I0)
    (htail : r < u * t → It ≤ I0 * Real.exp (-(u * t - r) ^ 2 / (4 * D * t))) :
    u * t - 2 * Real.sqrt (D * Real.log (I0 / It)) * Real.sqrt t ≤ r

declarations.name: completing_square

theorem completing_square {u w c t : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hwu : w < u) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    u * t - c * Real.sqrt t - w * (t - c ^ 2 / (4 * w * (u - w)))
      = (u - w) * (Real.sqrt t - c / (2 * (u - w))) ^ 2

theorem carrier_radius {u w c t r : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hwu : w < u) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hr : u * t - c * Real.sqrt t ≤ r) :
    w * (t - c ^ 2 / (4 * w * (u - w))) ≤ r

declarations.name: x3_delayed_recovery_work

declarations.name: universal_protection
declarations.signature:
theorem universal_protection {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
                             
    (accounts : Finset ι) (E : ι → Set Ω) (δ : ι → ENNReal) (G : Set Ω)
    (hG : Gᶜ ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ accounts, E i) (hδ : ∀ i ∈ accounts, μ (E i) ≤ δ i)
                                                                     
    (p : S → A) (T : Ω → S → C → Ev → S) (U : Ω → A → C → Ev → A)
    (obsS : S → O) (obsA : A → O) (ctrl : Ω → List O → C) (env : Ω → List O → C → Ev)
    (s₀ : Ω → S)
                                                                     
    (continues : A → Part → Prop) (R H : Part → Prop) (hcover : ∀ x, R x ∨ H x)
    (hcert : ∀ ω ∈ G, (∀ s c e, p (T ω s c e) = U ω (p s) c e) ∧
      (∀ s, obsS s = obsA (p s)) ∧ (∀ x, continues (p (s₀ ω)) x) ∧
      (∀ x, R x → ∀ a c e, continues a x → continues (U ω a c e) x) ∧
      (∀ x, H x → ∀ a c e, continues a x → continues (U ω a c e) x))
    (horizon : ℕ)
                               
    {n : ℕ} {L : Fin n → Type*} [∀ i, SemilatticeSup (L i)] {F : Set (∀ i, L i)}
    (hF : ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ⊔ y ∈ F) {o : ∀ i, L i} (ho : Aligned F o)
    (hn : 0 < n) (keeps : L ⟨0, hn⟩ → Part → Prop)
    (hkeeps : ∀ x y, x ≤ y → ∀ m, keeps x m → keeps y m) :
                                                         
    (∀ ω ∈ G, ∀ k ≤ horizon, ∀ x, continues (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x) ∧
                             
    μ {ω | ∃ k ≤ horizon, ¬ ∀ x, continues (p (run (T ω) obsS (ctrl ω) (env ω) (s₀ ω) k).1) x}
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ accounts, δ i ∧
                                                
    (∀ q ∈ F, q = o ∨ LexLt q o) ∧
                  
    (∀ q ∈ F, ∀ m, keeps (q ⟨0, hn⟩) m → keeps (o ⟨0, hn⟩) m)

theorem monopoly_exceeds_uniform {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) {m α : ℚ} (hpos : 0 < m + α)
    (dist_sq : Fin n → Fin n → ℚ) (Dem : RoutingDemand n) (hreg : Regular m dist_sq Dem)
    (s : Fin n → ℚ) (hs : hhiQ s = 1) :
    conservedPsi dist_sq α (fun _ => 1/(n:ℚ)) Dem < conservedPsi dist_sq α s Dem

declarations.name: h8_exact_general
declarations.signature:
theorem h8_exact_general {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) {m α : ℚ} (dist_sq : Fin n → Fin n → ℚ)
    (Dem : RoutingDemand n) (hreg : Regular m dist_sq Dem) (s : Fin n → ℚ) :
    conservedPsi dist_sq α s Dem
      = conservedPsi dist_sq α (fun _ => 1/(n:ℚ)) Dem
          * (1 + (n - 1)*(hhiQ s - 1/(n:ℚ))/(1 - 1/(n:ℚ)))
